sections.Aims and Fit of Module: To introduce advanced level of selected analytical techniques and data analysis methods.
sections.Learning outcomes: A critically discuss the importance of analytical chemistry in a wide range of application areas B demonstrate good understanding of the background theories of analytical techniques covered C demonstrate good understanding of the theories behind instrumental configuration and the data collection mechanisms D appreciate the differences between ‘limitations of technique’ and ‘machine limitation’ E critically interpret data using graphical/numerical and statistical techniques
